cues: But surely it is right to hate those who do harm?
Hatred of evil is itself a kind of bondage to evil: hate them, and you will probably become as harmful as they are, and you will not persuade them to change.
The way out is through understanding, not hate.
And he adds a precaution: this is not non resistance.
Resist, but with the greatest understanding and the smallest force needed to protect what is good.
